lines: | **`benchmark/2026-10-03-white-residual-u13/`** | **White/black residual after U13 (cc-t3): the 9 C15 keys (none ran in U13 windows 1-2; latest U12 runs) are M2 full-screen WebView x6 and M3 GLSurfaceView EGL IAE x3, each 0/60 lit U13 keys (81 runs); WebView proxy marker is in 81/81 lit runs (not a cause). U14 changes only jiten (M5 raises its own chooseServer dialog). M3 root unchanged in U13: EGLImpl from_surface = dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT) once with no fallback, while the runtime exports ANativeWindow_fromSurface -> one-function fix, 3 keys conditional. fd-tutanota is M2, not dead.** |

- 2026-10-03 **白残余 9 键 = M2×6 + M3×3,亮键 0/60(cc-t3)**:U13 窗1/2 一个都没跑到,用 U12;整屏 WebView(M2)与 GLSurfaceView EGL IAE(M3)在 U13 的 60 个亮键 81 次运行里都是 0;WebView 代理注入标记 81/81 亮运行都有——不是白因。U14 只动 jiten(M5 把它自己的 chooseServer 对话框抬上来)。M3 根在运行时 EGLImpl:from_surface 只做一次 dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT,"ANativeWindow_fromSurface") 不回退,而运行时自己就导出该符号(0x197388),同文件的 unwrap 解析却有 NOLOAD 回退;U13 未改任何 EGL 函数(equiv)。fd-tutanota 是 M2(本地 index.html),不是死。
